White House Reviews Candidates to Replace Pentagon Deputy

The White House is reportedly reviewing potential candidates to replace Deputy Secretary of Defense Steve Feinberg. While sources indicate this review is underway, no decision has been made to remove him. The specific reasons for the review and the candidates being considered have not been disclosed.
